section_1_cloze.passage:
The day of the surgery twenty-eight years ago still remains vivid in Hodge-Williams' memory.
That morning, she was [41] into the surgical room on a surgical cart. She remembers being [42] by doctors, the noise of their metal surgical tools and the feeling of being [43].
"They were getting on with their jobs, not realizing I was really [44]," she said.
But that [45] when the anesthesiologist (麻醉师) arrived. Hodge-Williams recalled he had a kind [46] and a cap covered in sunflowers.
"Seeing my fear, he said to me, 'OK, why not think about something you like?' At first, I felt quite [47], 'How could he ask me this question when I was so fearful!'"
"In a kind of silly manner, I replied, 'Well, what do you like?' And very [48], he said, 'Singing.'"
So Hodge-Williams asked him to [49]. "Then he started singing 'The Phantom of the Opera,' which accompanied me to gradually [50]."
In the years since that day, Hodge-Williams has experienced multiple surgeries. But she still imagines that doctor [51].
"I can [52] him almost with me through every surgery: his calm and [53] voice, his gentle and relaxed smile... They meant much to me, not just the science of medicine, but also the [54] and care for me. Although I don't know his name, I will always be [55] to him." Hodge-Williams said.

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。空后提到“on a surgical cart”（在手术推车上），cart是有轮子的，因此使用wheel的动词形式，表示“用推车推”。
questions.supplement:
A(dragged)：语境句：The heavy box was dragged across the floor. 固定搭配：drag on, drag down
B(showed)：语境句：She showed me around the campus. 固定搭配：show off, show up
C(carried)：语境句：He carried the injured child to safety. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on
D(wheeled)：语境句：The patient was wheeled into the operating room. 固定搭配：wheel around, behind the wheel

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。根据常识和语境，在手术室里，病人躺在手术台上，医生们“围在”周围(surrounded)准备手术。Cared需加for，treated意为“治疗/对待”，不如surrounded具体贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(surrounded)：语境句：The house is surrounded by beautiful trees. 固定搭配：be surrounded by/with, surround sound
B(supported)：语境句：The roof is supported by wooden pillars. 固定搭配：support oneself, in support of
C(cared)：语境句：He deeply cared about his students' future. 固定搭配：care for, care about
D(treated)：语境句：The doctor treated her for a rare disease. 固定搭配：treat sb to sth, treat as

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。虽然周围有很多医生，但下文提到医生们各自忙碌“not realizing I was really terrified”，这让身处金属器械噪音中的作者感到孤立无援(alone)。
questions.supplement:
A(tired)：语境句：She was too tired to go out tonight. 固定搭配：be tired of, be tired out
B(alone)：语境句：She felt completely alone in the big city. 固定搭配：let alone, leave sb alone
C(eager)：语境句：He is eager to learn new skills. 固定搭配：be eager for, be eager to do
D(annoyed)：语境句：He was annoyed at her constant interruptions. 固定搭配：be annoyed with sb, be annoyed at/about sth

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。根据第五段第一句“Seeing my fear”和最后一句“when I was so fearful”可知，作者当时非常恐惧(terrified)。
questions.supplement:
A(excited)：语境句：The kids were excited about the upcoming trip. 固定搭配：be excited about, get excited
B(curious)：语境句：I was curious to know what they were discussing. 固定搭配：be curious about, out of curiosity
C(terrified)：语境句：She was absolutely terrified of spiders. 固定搭配：be terrified of, be terrified to do
D(awkward)：语境句：There was an awkward silence in the room. 固定搭配：feel awkward, awkward situation

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文描述了冷冰冰且令人恐惧的手术室氛围，而“But”表示转折，说明麻醉师到来后，这种情况发生了“改变”(changed)。
questions.supplement:
A(worsened)：语境句：The weather worsened rapidly overnight. 固定搭配：worsen the situation, continually worsen
B(developed)：语境句：She developed a deep interest in art. 固定搭配：develop into, develop a habit
C(changed)：语境句：His attitude changed after hearing the truth. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
D(repeated)：语境句：He repeated his question because no one answered. 固定搭配：repeat oneself, repeat after me

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。空处与后文的“a cap covered in sunflowers”并列，是作者肉眼看到的麻醉师的外貌特征。结合后文提到的“gentle and relaxed smile”，可知他带着和善的“微笑”(smile)。
questions.supplement:
A(smile)：语境句：She greeted the guests with a warm smile. 固定搭配：smile at, all smiles
B(heart)：语境句：He has a kind heart and helps everyone. 固定搭配：by heart, lose heart
C(order)：语境句：The books are arranged in alphabetical order. 固定搭配：in order to, out of order
D(comment)：语境句：He made no comment on the recent event. 固定搭配：make a comment, no comment

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。作者当时非常害怕，而医生却问她“喜欢什么”，作者的第一反应是觉得这个问题很“奇怪/反常”(strange)。
questions.supplement:
A(desperate)：语境句：They made a desperate attempt to save the company. 固定搭配：be desperate for, in a desperate situation
B(strange)：语境句：It is strange that he hasn't arrived yet. 固定搭配：feel strange, look strange
C(ashamed)：语境句：He felt ashamed of his rude behavior. 固定搭配：be ashamed of, feel ashamed for
D(depressed)：语境句：She felt lonely and depressed after moving. 固定搭配：feel depressed, clinically depressed

questions.explanation: 本题考查副词辨析。医生为了安抚极度恐惧的作者，其态度必然是镇定的、平静的(calmly)。这与后文提到的“calm and comforting voice”相呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(confidently)：语境句：She answered the interviewer's questions confidently. 固定搭配：speak confidently, act confidently
B(calmly)：语境句：He reacted calmly to the unexpected emergency. 固定搭配：deal with calmly, breathe calmly
C(politely)：语境句：The waiter smiled and politely took our order. 固定搭配：decline politely, listen politely
D(proudly)：语境句：He proudly displayed his gold medal to the crowd. 固定搭配：proudly present, announce proudly

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。前文医生说自己喜欢“Singing(唱歌)”，顺理成章地，作者就请求他“唱”(sing)一首。
questions.supplement:
A(leave)：语境句：It's time for us to leave the party. 固定搭配：leave for, leave alone
B(continue)：语境句：The rain will continue throughout the night. 固定搭配：continue to do, continue doing
C(listen)：语境句：You should listen carefully to the instructions. 固定搭配：listen to, listen in
D(sing)：语境句：She loves to sing in the shower. 固定搭配：sing a song, sing along

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。麻醉师的职责是进行麻醉，随着麻醉药效发挥，再加上舒缓的歌声，作者逐渐“入睡”(fall asleep)。
questions.supplement:
A(come to life)：语境句：The quiet town comes to life during the festival. 固定搭配：bring to life, come back to life
B(hold my breath)：语境句：I had to hold my breath underwater for a minute. 固定搭配：hold one's breath, catch one's breath
C(pay attention)：语境句：Please pay attention to the warning signs. 固定搭配：pay attention to, attract attention
D(fall asleep)：语境句：He was so exhausted that he fell asleep immediately. 固定搭配：fall asleep, fast asleep

questions.explanation: 本题考查介词短语辨析。多年后作者经历了多次手术，虽然那个医生不在现场，但她依然想象他就在“自己身边”(by her side)陪伴着她。下文“almost with me”是重要提示。
questions.supplement:
A(in the way)：语境句：I couldn't move because a chair was in the way. 固定搭配：in the way, stand in the way
B(out of sight)：语境句：The ship sailed until it was out of sight. 固定搭配：out of sight, out of mind
C(by her side)：语境句：Her loyal dog was always by her side. 固定搭配：by one's side, side by side
D(in a hurry)：语境句：He left the office in a hurry to catch the train. 固定搭配：in a hurry, hurry up

questions.explanation: 本题考查动词辨析。因为医生实际并不在场（上文用了imagines），所以作者是通过想象在脑海中“描绘/浮现”(picture)出他陪伴在旁的画面。
questions.supplement:
A(picture)：语境句：Try to picture yourself lying on a sunny beach. 固定搭配：picture sb doing sth, get the picture
B(notice)：语境句：Did you notice any changes in his behavior? 固定搭配：take notice of, notice sb doing
C(remember)：语境句：I can't remember where I left my keys. 固定搭配：remember to do, remember doing
D(hear)：语境句：I could hear the birds singing outside my window. 固定搭配：hear of, hear from

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。空处与calm并列，修饰voice，表示麻醉师的声音是平静且“令人安慰的/抚慰人心的”(comforting)。
questions.supplement:
A(unique)：语境句：Everyone's fingerprints are absolutely unique. 固定搭配：unique to, unique style
B(comforting)：语境句：A hot cup of tea is very comforting in winter. 固定搭配：comforting words, a comforting thought
C(loud)：语境句：The loud music kept the neighbors awake all night. 固定搭配：out loud, loud and clear
D(clear)：语境句：The instructions must be clear and easy to follow. 固定搭配：make it clear, clear up

questions.explanation: 本题考查名词辨析。空处与care(关爱)并列。不仅仅是医学技术，还有对病人的共情与“同情”(sympathy)。在医疗语境中，sympathy常指对病人痛苦的理解和同情心。
questions.supplement:
A(inspiration)：语境句：Nature has always been a great inspiration for artists. 固定搭配：draw inspiration from, a source of inspiration
B(praise)：语境句：The firefighters received high praise for their bravery. 固定搭配：in praise of, win praise
C(sympathy)：语境句：We feel deep sympathy for the victims of the earthquake. 固定搭配：have sympathy for, out of sympathy
D(suggestion)：语境句：Can you offer any suggestions on how to improve this? 固定搭配：make a suggestion, open to suggestion

questions.explanation: 本题考查形容词辨析。尽管不知道医生的名字，但正是他的善意帮作者度过了恐惧，所以作者会永远对他心存“感激”(grateful)。固定搭配 be grateful to sb。
questions.supplement:
A(loyal)：语境句：He has been a loyal supporter of the team for years. 固定搭配：be loyal to, loyal customer
B(helpful)：语境句：Thank you for your very helpful advice. 固定搭配：be helpful to, prove helpful
C(sensitive)：语境句：Skin is often highly sensitive to the sun. 固定搭配：be sensitive to, highly sensitive
D(grateful)：语境句：I am deeply grateful for your continuous support. 固定搭配：be grateful to sb for sth, forever grateful

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stay clear and strong in memory
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 在记忆中保持清晰生动
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语第三人称单数时谓语用 remains；remain 是系动词，后接形容词 vivid 作表语，表示状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The details of that day remain vivid in my mind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那一天的细节在我脑海中依然生动清晰。
vocab_pack.from_passage: still remains vivid in Hodge-Williams' memory

vocab_pack.definition_en: to transport someone on a wheeled cart or gurney into a place
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 用轮车/推车把某人送进（某处）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，was wheeled into 表示主语被推入；wheeled 是 wheel 的过去分词，wheel 作动词意为「用轮车运送」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The patient was wheeled into the operating room.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 病人被用推车送进了手术室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she was wheeled into the surgical room

vocab_pack.definition_en: a room where surgeries are performed; operating room
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 手术室
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，surgical（外科的）作定语修饰 room，在句中作介词 into 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The nurse prepared the surgical room for the next operation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 护士为下一场手术准备好了手术室。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was wheeled into the surgical room

vocab_pack.definition_en: a wheeled table used to transport patients before surgery
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 手术推车
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，a 为不定冠词，surgical 作定语修饰 cart；在句中作介词 on 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The patient was moved onto a surgical cart.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 病人被移到了手术推车上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: on a surgical cart

vocab_pack.definition_en: to recall that one experienced or did something (using a gerund)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 记得曾经做过某事（后接动名词）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: remember + 动名词表示回忆过去做过的事情；本句中 being surrounded 是动名词的被动形式，表示「被包围」这个经历。
vocab_pack.example_en: I remember being taken to the airport as a child.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我记得小时候被送去机场。
vocab_pack.from_passage: She remembers being surrounded by doctors

vocab_pack.definition_en: the emotion of loneliness
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 孤独感
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，the feeling 为主语中心词，of being alone 是介词短语作后置定语，being alone 是动名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The feeling of being alone can be overwhelming.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孤独感可能会让人难以承受。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the feeling of being alone

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: were getting on with their jobs
vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something, especially work
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 继续做（尤指工作）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去进行时 were getting on with，表示当时正在继续工作；get on with 是固定短语，后接名词或代词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He got on with his homework despite the noise.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 尽管有噪音，他还是继续做作业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They were getting on with their jobs

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become aware of something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 意识到，认识到
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语 not realizing 作伴随状语，表示医生们在做自己的事，没有意识到她的恐惧。
vocab_pack.example_en: He walked past me, not realizing I was there.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他走过我身边，没有意识到我在那里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not realizing I was really terrified

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely frightened
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 极其恐惧的，吓坏的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系表结构，was terrified 中 terrified 是形容词作表语；really 是副词修饰 terrified。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was terrified of the dark.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她非常害怕黑暗。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was really terrified

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become different
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 改变，变化
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，changed 是 change 的过去式，在句中作谓语，主语 that 指代前文的情况。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everything changed when she arrived.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她来了之后一切都变了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: But that changed when the anesthesiologist arrived

vocab_pack.definition_en: a doctor who administers anesthesia
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 麻醉科医师，麻醉师
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 普通名词，在句中作主语，前有定冠词 the 特指那位麻醉师。
vocab_pack.example_en: The anesthesiologist carefully monitored the patient's breathing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 麻醉师仔细监测着病人的呼吸。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when the anesthesiologist arrived

vocab_pack.definition_en: a friendly and gentle smile
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 善意的微笑
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，kind 作形容词修饰 smile，前有不定冠词 a，在句中作 had 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She greeted me with a kind smile.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她面带善意的微笑向我打招呼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he had a kind smile

vocab_pack.definition_en: having a surface completely covered with something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 布满……的，覆盖着……的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语 covered in 作后置定语修饰 cap，表示帽子上布满了向日葵图案；covered 是 cover 的过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The table was covered in flowers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 桌子上摆满了花。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a cap covered in sunflowers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to notice or become aware of someone's fear
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 看到某人的恐惧
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语 Seeing my fear 作状语，表示谓语动作发生时伴随的情况；see 的主动形式，逻辑主语是主句主语 he。
vocab_pack.example_en: Seeing his hesitation, she encouraged him.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 看到他的犹豫，她鼓励了他。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Seeing my fear, he said to me

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: why not think about something you like
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to make a suggestion; 'why don't you do something?'
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 为什么不……？（表建议）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定句式 why not + 动词原形，省略主语 you，表示提出建议。
vocab_pack.example_en: Why not take a break? You've been working hard.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 为什么不休息一下？你一直在努力工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 'OK, why not think about something you like?'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience an unusual or uncomfortable feeling
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 感到奇怪/异样
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系动词 feel + 形容词 strange，过去式 felt；quite 是程度副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: I felt strange after hearing the news.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听到那个消息后我感觉很奇怪。
vocab_pack.from_passage: At first, I felt quite strange

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: in a kind of silly manner
vocab_pack.definition_en: in a particular way or style
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 以……的方式
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，manner 表示方式；kind of 修饰 silly，意为「有点傻的」。
vocab_pack.example_en: He spoke in a calm manner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他以平静的方式说话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In a kind of silly manner, I replied

vocab_pack.definition_en: to answer
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 回答，回复
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，replied 是 reply 的过去式，在句中作谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She replied to the question quickly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她迅速回答了那个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I replied, 'Well, what do you like?'

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a calm and relaxed manner
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 平静地，沉着地
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词 very calmly 修饰谓语 said，表示说话的方式；calmly 是形容词 calm 加 -ly 构成。
vocab_pack.example_en: He calmly explained the situation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他平静地解释了情况。
vocab_pack.from_passage: And very calmly, he said, 'Singing.'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to begin an action (using a gerund)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 开始做某事（后接动名词）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: start + 动名词，表示开始唱歌；started 是 start 的过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: She started crying when she heard the news.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听到消息后她开始哭了起来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Then he started singing 'The Phantom of the Opera'

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: accompanied me to gradually fall asleep
vocab_pack.definition_en: to be with someone and help them do something, often by creating a certain atmosphere
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 陪伴某人做某事（常指帮助或促成）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: accompany 是及物动词，后接宾语 me；to gradually fall asleep 是不定式短语作宾语补足语，表示目的或结果。
vocab_pack.example_en: The soft music accompanied her to fall asleep.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 轻柔的音乐伴她入睡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which accompanied me to gradually fall asleep

vocab_pack.definition_en: to begin sleeping
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 入睡，睡着
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词原形 fall asleep 在不定式 to gradually fall asleep 中；fall 是系动词，asleep 是形容词作表语；gradually 是副词修饰 fall asleep。
vocab_pack.example_en: She fell asleep quickly after the long day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 漫长的一天后她很快就睡着了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to gradually fall asleep

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: In the years since that day
vocab_pack.definition_en: during the period after a particular event
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 从那天以来的这些年里
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，since that day 修饰 the years，表示从那一天之后的时间。
vocab_pack.example_en: In the years since the accident, he changed his lifestyle.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 事故发生后的这些年里，他改变了生活方式。
vocab_pack.from_passage: In the years since that day

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go through an event or feeling
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 经历，体验
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 has experienced，主语是第三人称单数 Hodge-Williams，强调从过去至今的经历。
vocab_pack.example_en: She has experienced many challenges in her life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她一生中经历了许多挑战。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Hodge-Williams has experienced multiple surgeries

vocab_pack.definition_en: many; several
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 多个的，多种的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰可数名词复数 surgeries，表示多次手术。
vocab_pack.example_en: He underwent multiple tests.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他接受了多项检查。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has experienced multiple surgeries

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: imagines that doctor by her side
vocab_pack.definition_en: to picture a person being with you, especially for support
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 想象某人在自己身边（尤指给予支持）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，imagines 是 imagine 的第三人称单数形式；that doctor 是宾语，by her side 是介词短语作宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She often imagines her mother by her side during difficult times.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在困难时刻，她常常想象母亲就在身边。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she still imagines that doctor by her side

vocab_pack.definition_en: to visualize or imagine someone or something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 想象，设想
vocab_pack.grammar_note: picture 在这里作动词，后接宾语 him；can picture 表示有能力想象。
vocab_pack.example_en: I can picture you winning the race.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我可以想象你赢得比赛的样子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I can picture him almost with me through every surgery

vocab_pack.definition_en: peaceful and soothing; giving a sense of security
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 平静而令人安慰的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 两个形容词用 and 并列，修饰 voice；calm 是形容词，comforting 是动词 comfort 的现在分词作形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: He spoke in a calm and comforting tone.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他用平静而令人安慰的语气说话。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his calm and comforting voice

vocab_pack.definition_en: soft and not tense; friendly and at ease
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 温柔而放松的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 两个形容词并列修饰 smile；gentle 是形容词，relaxed 是动词 relax 的过去分词作形容词，表示舒展的。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her gentle and relaxed smile put everyone at ease.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她温柔而放松的微笑让每个人都感到自在。
vocab_pack.from_passage: his gentle and relaxed smile

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be very important or significant to someone
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 对某人意义重大/很重要
vocab_pack.grammar_note: mean 的过去式 meant，much 作副词表示程度；to me 说明对谁重要。
vocab_pack.example_en: Your support means a lot to me.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你的支持对我来说意义重大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: They meant much to me

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: not just the science of medicine, but also the sympathy and care
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to emphasize that both of two things are true
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 不仅……而且……
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 并列结构，连接两个名词短语 the science of medicine 和 the sympathy and care，强调两方面都重要。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is not just a teacher but also a mentor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他不仅是一位老师，更是一位导师。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not just the science of medicine, but also the sympathy and care for me

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling thankfulness toward someone
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 感激某人
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系表结构，will be grateful；grateful 是形容词，后接介词 to + 宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am grateful to my parents for their support.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我感激我的父母给予的支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I will always be grateful to him

section_2_word_form.passage:
"Roars the Yangtze River, sweeping everything eastward; the currents surge, in an unremitting way just like the emergence and disappearance of these shining [56] in history," chanted Ming Dynasty scholar Yang Shen in his poem, while [57] through Luzhou, Sichuan province, attracted by the river scene.
The river has nurtured (养育) and witnessed the progress of Chinese civilization [58] in return, artists over centuries have never stopped describing it [59] great respect.
Recent examples of these descriptions [60] at New Scenery of the Yangtze River on Sept 14, an exhibition in Wuhan. More than 100 paintings, watercolors, photos and mixed media works [61] at the exhibition presented varied [62] landscapes and dynamic cultures along the waterway.
At the exhibition, Quiet Nature, a group of drawings by ink artist Liu Wanming, shows the much-beloved giant panda not only to reflect its appeal but also to attempt to protect this species and its environment. Liu says [63] has been guiding his creation is an idea of Chinese philosophy — to pursue [64] in the treatment of details, while to present the extensiveness of the world. It is a wisdom that keeps reminding people to observe nature, to consider from the standpoints of other lives, and [65] to get along with the world.

questions.explanation: 考查名词复数。figure在此意为“人物（尤指历史或著名人物）”。前有these修饰，故需用复数形式figures。
questions.supplement: 正确形(figures)：语境句：Many historical figures played important roles in this event. 固定搭配：historical figures, public figures。原词figure其它变形：figurative(adj.)比喻的, figure out(v. phrase)弄明白。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。此处为状语从句的省略（或分词作状语），主语Yang Shen与journey（旅行）之间是主动关系，且在进行中，故用现在分词journeying，即while (he was) journeying的省略。
questions.supplement: 正确形(journeying)：语境句：While journeying across the country, she kept a daily diary. 固定搭配：journey through, begin a journey (n.)。原词journey其它搭配：make a journey, a long journey。

questions.explanation: 考查连词。前后两部分“The river has nurtured...”与“in return, artists... have never stopped...”构成完整的并列句，表示“长江孕育了文明，作为回报（同时），艺术家们也不断描绘它”，填并列连词and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He worked hard, and eventually achieved his goal. 固定搭配：and so on, both... and...。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。表示“带着极大的敬意”，固定搭配为 with great respect。
questions.supplement: 正确形(with)：语境句：The students greeted their professor with great respect. 固定搭配：with respect, treat sb with respect。

questions.explanation: 考查动词时态和语态。主语是Recent examples，表示复数；时间状语是on Sept 14（过去的具体时间），故用一般过去时。examples与show是被动关系，故填were shown。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were shown)：语境句：The new products were shown at the international exhibition last week. 固定搭配：be shown to, show off。原词show其它变形：showing(n./v-ing), showy(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词。句子的谓语动词是presented，works与display之间是被动关系，用过去分词作后置定语，修饰works，意为“在展览上被展出的作品”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(displayed)：语境句：All the artifacts displayed in the museum are over a thousand years old. 固定搭配：be displayed on/at, proudly displayed。原词display其它变形：display(n.)展览。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。修饰名词landscapes（风景），需要用nature的形容词形式natural（自然的）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(natural)：语境句：The country is famous for its stunning natural beauty. 固定搭配：natural resources, natural disaster。原词nature其它变形：naturally(adv.), naturalist(n.)。

questions.explanation: 考查主语从句。空处引导主语从句“___ has been guiding his creation”，且在从句中充当主语，表示“……的事物”，故填what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What surprised me most was his sudden decision to quit. 固定搭配：what to do, no matter what。

questions.explanation: 考查词性转换。pursue是及物动词，其后需要接名词作宾语，accurate（准确的）的名词形式是accuracy（准确性）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(accuracy)：语境句：The journalist always checks her facts to ensure accuracy. 固定搭配：with accuracy, high accuracy。原词accurate其它变形：accurately(adv.), inaccurate(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 考查非谓语动词并列。与前文的“to observe nature, to consider from the standpoints... ”构成不定式的并列结构，故填to learn（填learn也可接受，但补全to更符合严格的排比对称结构）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to learn)：语境句：It is never too late to learn a new language. 固定搭配：learn to do, learn from。原词learn其它变形：learned(adj.)博学的, learning(n.), learner(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: (of a river, wind, etc.) make a loud, deep sound
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 怒吼；咆哮（指河流、风等发出低沉巨响）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句为倒装结构，正常语序为 The Yangtze River roars。Roars 置于句首表示强调，主语 The Yangtze River 单数，谓语用一般现在时第三人称单数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Pacific Ocean roars against the cliffs during the storm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 暴风雨中，太平洋怒涛拍打峭壁。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Roars the Yangtze River

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move swiftly and powerfully, carrying everything along
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 席卷；扫荡（快速而有力地移动，携带一切）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词作伴随状语，表示主语（Yangtze River）在咆哮的同时「席卷一切向东」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The flood swept away entire villages.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 洪水席卷了整个村庄。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sweeping everything eastward

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rise or move forward in a powerful wave-like motion
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 汹涌；奔腾（如波浪般强烈上升或前进）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 currents 为复数，谓语用动词原形 surge。
vocab_pack.example_en: The crowd surged forward as the gates opened.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大门一开，人群向前涌去。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the currents surge

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of coming into view or becoming known
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 出现；显现（进入视野或为人所知的过程）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，与 disappearance 并列，作介词 like 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The emergence of new technologies changed the industry.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新技术的出现改变了这个行业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the emergence and disappearance of these shining figures

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act or fact of ceasing to be visible or existing
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 消失；消亡（不再可见或不再存在）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，与 emergence 并列，共同作介词 like 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The disappearance of the ancient civilization remains a mystery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那个古代文明的消失仍然是一个谜。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the emergence and disappearance of these shining figures

vocab_pack.definition_en: to sing or recite in a rhythmic, often repetitive way
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 吟诵；咏唱（有节奏地、往往重复地唱或朗诵）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，表示诗人杨慎在诗中「吟诵」了上面这句话。
vocab_pack.example_en: The monks chanted their prayers every morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 僧人们每天早上吟诵祷文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "…" chanted Ming Dynasty scholar Yang Shen

vocab_pack.definition_en: to travel across or through a place
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 穿越；旅行经过（某地）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作时间状语，与 while 连用，表示「在穿越泸州途中」。
vocab_pack.example_en: They journeyed through the desert for three days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们花了三天时间穿越沙漠。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while journeying through Luzhou

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to be interested or drawn to something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 吸引；引起（兴趣或注意）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作状语，表示主语 Yang Shen 处于「被江景吸引」的状态，attracted 是 attract 的过去分词，by 引出施动者。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bright colors attracted many butterflies.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鲜艳的色彩吸引了许多蝴蝶。
vocab_pack.from_passage: attracted by the river scene

vocab_pack.definition_en: to care for and help something grow or develop
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 养育；培育（照顾并促进成长或发展）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 has nurtured，主语 the river 单数，与 witnessed 并列，表示长江「养育了」中华文明。
vocab_pack.example_en: Parents nurture their children with love and patience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 父母用爱和耐心养育孩子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The river has nurtured and witnessed the progress

vocab_pack.definition_en: to see an event take place; to be present at
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 见证；目睹（某事发生；在场）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 has witnessed，与 nurtured 并列，表示长江「见证了」中华文明的进步。
vocab_pack.example_en: This old building has witnessed many historical events.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座老建筑见证了许多历史事件。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has nurtured and witnessed the progress

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a response or reciprocal action
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 作为回报；反过来
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰后文 artists have never stopped describing it，表示「作为（长江养育文明的）回报，艺术家们从未停止描绘它」。
vocab_pack.example_en: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and in return, artists over centuries have never stopped describing it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something without ceasing
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 从未停止做某事
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时 have never stopped + 动名词 describing，表示从过去到现在一直持续的行为。never 否定，stopped 为 stop 的过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She never stops learning new things.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她从未停止学习新事物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have never stopped describing it with great respect

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a manner showing deep admiration and deference
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 怀着极大的敬意
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰 describing，说明艺术家们如何描绘长江。
vocab_pack.example_en: He spoke of his teacher with great respect.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他怀着极大的敬意谈到他的老师。
vocab_pack.from_passage: describing it with great respect

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be displayed or exhibited at a place
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 展示；展出（在某地被陈列或展览）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态一般过去时，were shown 表示展品被展出，at 引出地点。主语 examples 复数，故用 were。
vocab_pack.example_en: His photographs were shown at the international exhibition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他的摄影作品在国际展览上展出。
vocab_pack.from_passage: were shown at New Scenery of the Yangtze River

vocab_pack.definition_en: artworks that combine different materials or techniques
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 混合媒介作品（综合不同材料或技巧的艺术作品）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: mixed 是过去分词作定语，修饰 media（复数形式，原形 medium），整体作名词短语与 paintings 等并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: Mixed media allows artists to experiment with textures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 混合媒介让艺术家能够尝试不同的质感。
vocab_pack.from_passage: paintings, watercolors, photos and mixed media works

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something on show for people to see
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 陈列；展示（将某物展出供人观看）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作定语，修饰 works，表示「被展出的作品」。displayed 是 display 的过去分词，at 引出展览地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: The museum displayed ancient artifacts from Egypt.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 博物馆展出了来自埃及的古代文物。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the paintings… displayed at the exhibition

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or offer something for consideration
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 呈现；展现（展示或提供某物供考虑）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语 works (复数) 后接 presented，表示这些作品「呈现了」多样的自然景观。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report presented a clear picture of the situation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份报告清晰地呈现了局势。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented varied natural landscapes and dynamic cultures

vocab_pack.definition_en: characterized by constant change, activity, or progress
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 动态的；充满活力的（不断变化、活跃或进步的）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 cultures，与 varied natural landscapes 并列，表示「充满活力的文化」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The city has a dynamic economy and a vibrant culture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市拥有充满活力的经济和蓬勃的文化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: varied natural landscapes and dynamic cultures

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: not only to reflect its appeal but also to attempt
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to connect two parallel elements, emphasizing both
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 不仅……而且……（用于连接两个并列成分，强调两者）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原句连接两个不定式短语 to reflect 和 to attempt，表示这幅画「不仅反映大熊猫的魅力，而且试图保护它」。
vocab_pack.example_en: She not only sings well but also dances gracefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她不仅歌唱得好，而且舞姿优美。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not only to reflect its appeal but also to attempt to protect this species

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show or be a sign of a particular quality or feature
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 反映；体现（显示或象征某种特质或特征）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to reflect 作目的状语，意为「为了反映它的魅力」。reflect 是动词原形，后接宾语 its appeal。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her calm expression reflects her inner confidence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她平静的表情反映了她内心的自信。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to reflect its appeal

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep someone or something safe from harm or damage
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 保护（使免受伤害或破坏）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to attempt to protect 中，protect 为动词原形，与 this species 构成动宾结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should protect endangered species from extinction.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该保护濒危物种免于灭绝。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to protect this species and its environment

vocab_pack.definition_en: to direct or influence the course of action or thought
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 指导；引导（指引或影响行动或思想的走向）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成进行时 has been guiding，表示一种观念一直「在指导」他的创作。guiding 是 guide 的现在分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Principles of fairness guide his decisions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公平原则指导着他的决策。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what has been guiding his creation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow or strive for something with determination
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 追求；致力于（坚定地追寻或努力达到某目标）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to pursue accuracy 与后文 to present 并列，作表语说明理念内容。pursue 是动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists pursue truth through careful experimentation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家通过仔细的实验追求真理。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to pursue accuracy in the treatment of details

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality of covering a large area or range
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 广阔；广泛（覆盖大面积或大范围的性质）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作 present 的宾语，表示「呈现世界的广阔」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The extensiveness of the desert amazed the explorers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 沙漠的广阔令探险者惊叹。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to present the extensiveness of the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue doing something repeatedly or habitually
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 一直做某事；不断做某事（反复或习惯性地继续）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 it 单数，keeps 是 keep 的第三人称单数形式，后接动名词 reminding，表示这种智慧「不断提醒」人们。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher keeps encouraging her students to ask questions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师不断鼓励她的学生提问。
vocab_pack.from_passage: keeps reminding people to observe nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: to watch carefully, especially to learn something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 观察（仔细观看，尤其为了学习）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: to observe nature 是动词不定式短语，作宾语补足语（接在 reminds people to 后），表示提醒人们去「观察自然」。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists observe animal behavior in the wild.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家在野外观察动物行为。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to observe nature

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular way of thinking about a situation; point of view
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 角度；立场（思考某个情况的特定方式）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词复数形式，用于短语 from the standpoints of other lives，表示「从其他生命的立场」考虑。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should consider the problem from different standpoints.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该从不同的角度考虑这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: from the standpoints of other lives

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a friendly or harmonious relationship with someone or something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 与……相处融洽；与……和谐共处
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to learn to get along with the world 中，get along with 是固定短语动词，意为学会「与世界和谐相处」。
vocab_pack.example_en: It's important to get along with your colleagues.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 与同事和睦相处很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to learn to get along with the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: very much loved; adored by many
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 深受喜爱的；备受宠爱的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语修饰 giant panda，由副词 much 加过去分词 beloved 构成，表示「深受喜爱的大熊猫」。
vocab_pack.example_en: The much-beloved actor received a standing ovation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位深受喜爱的演员获得了起立鼓掌。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the much-beloved giant panda

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who studies a particular subject and has deep knowledge
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 学者（专门研究某领域且有深厚知识的人）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作同位语，说明杨慎的身份是「明代学者」。scholar 为单数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scholar published a groundbreaking paper on climate change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位学者发表了一篇关于气候变化的开创性论文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ming Dynasty scholar Yang Shen
